papers.abstract: Six proteomic aging clocks are deployed in a clinical trial for the first time, revealing more about the clocks than about the drug.
papers.titleZh: 蛋白體年齡時鐘首次進入臨床試驗
papers.summaryZh: 《Nature Biotechnology》報導，六種蛋白體年齡時鐘首次被部署於臨床試驗。研究顯示這次試驗揭示了更多關於時鐘本身的資訊，而非關於藥物的資訊。該結果反映了蛋白體年齡時鐘在臨床情境中的應用現況。

papers.title: In vivo engineering of CAR natural killer cells for immunotherapy using ligand-directed lipid nanoparticles
papers.abstract: Chimeric antigen receptor natural killer cells to treat autoimmune disease and cancer are generated in vivo.
papers.titleZh: 以配體導向脂質奈米粒子體內工程化 CAR 自然殺手細胞
papers.summaryZh: 該研究報導以配體導向脂質奈米粒子進行體內工程化，產生嵌合抗原受體自然殺手細胞。研究指出此類 CAR 自然殺手細胞可用於免疫治療。文中提及的治療方向包含自體免疫疾病與癌症。

papers.title: A unique and equity-driven approach to immunology education in low- and middle-income countries
papers.abstract: We present a model for education that has proven transformative for faculty and students, fostering mentorship, inclusion and cross-border collaboration. By embedding training in local contexts, our framework builds confidence, skills and leadership among early-career scientists. These elements foster scientific autonomy and enable sustainable global engagement.
papers.titleZh: 低中收入國家免疫學教育的公平導向模式
papers.summaryZh: 本文提出一種用於免疫學教育的模式，作者表示該模式對教師與學生具轉型效果。模式強調導師制度、包容性與跨國合作，並將培訓嵌入在地脈絡。透過此框架，早期職涯科學家在信心、技能與領導力方面獲得提升。作者指出，這些要素有助於培育科學自主性，並促進永續的全球參與。

papers.title: Eye movements reflect capacity-dependent organization of working memory
papers.abstract: Human cognition is capacity-limited, requiring strategies to actively structure information. Eye movements offer a natural mechanism for sequential sampling, but whether such sequences reflect memory organization is unknown. We developed a working-memory task where color-frequency pairings created a latent ordinal structure to optimally reduce memory load. Across two experiments, gaze patterns spontaneously aligned with this structure. Participants sampled items following this sequence during encoding and revisited them during maintenance. Critically, the expression of this structure depended on cognitive demand. In a 3-item task, high performers showed robust sequential sampling during encoding, whereas lower performers compensated with replay-like revisitation during maintenance. Under higher demand (4 items), encoding-based organization was disrupted, and structured revisitation emerged primarily during maintenance. These findings suggest that eye movements provide an overt expression of an internally generated organizational process that flexibly adapts to cognitive demands, revealing a behavioral analogue to neural replay when encoding resources are strained.
papers.titleZh: 眼動反映工作記憶的容量依賴性組織
papers.summaryZh: 研究開發一個工作記憶任務，利用顏色-頻率配對創造潛在序位結構以降低記憶負荷。兩項實驗發現注視模式自發與此結構一致，參與者在編碼時依序取樣項目，維持期則回訪該項目。結構的表現依認知需求而異。在三項目任務中，高表現者於編碼期呈現穩健的序位取樣，而低表現者則以類似重播的回訪來補償，發生於維持期。在更高需求的四項目條件下，編碼期的組織受干擾，結構化回訪主要出現在維持期。結果顯示眼動提供內部產生的組織過程的外顯表現，能依認知需求彈性調整，並在編碼資源受限時呈現類似神經重播的行為對應。

papers.title: Interindividual vocal tract diversity influences the phonetic diversification of spoken languages
papers.abstract: Human vocal tracts, like other physical traits, exhibit extensive interindividual variation. However, little is known about how this variation translates into phonetic diversity between speakers, and ultimately, across languages. Here we develop a biocultural model of phonetic evolution, analogous to Russell Lande’s model of multivariate phenotypic evolution. We show that individual vocal tract morphologies and associated articulatory strategies leave consistent acoustic signatures, resulting in a characteristic pattern of phonetic variation within speaker groups that correlates with the pattern observed between groups. Recalling a central tenet of evolutionary biology—that within-group variation feeds between-group diversification—our findings suggest that phonologically similar vowel systems can attain phonetically diverse realizations according to a neutral-like evolutionary process. Our model serves as a null hypothesis for disentangling the biological versus cultural mechanisms underlying phonetic diversification, where deviations from the neutral expectation may indicate culturally mediated language change.
papers.titleZh: 個體發音道差異影響語言音韻多樣化
papers.summaryZh: 本研究指出人類發音道如同其他身體特徵一樣存在廣泛的個體間變異，但此變異如何轉化為說話者間的音韻多樣性，以及最終跨語言的差異仍知之甚少。作者發展出一個類比於 Russell Lande 多變量表型演化模型的生物文化音韻演化模型。研究顯示個體發音道形態及其相關的發音策略會留下一致的聲學特徵，導致說話者群體內的音韻變異模式與群體間的模式相關。作者援引演化生物學中「群內變異促進群間分化」的觀點，提出音系上相似的元音系統可透過類似中性的演化過程獲得音韻上多樣的實現。該模型可作為區分音韻多樣化背後生物與文化機制的零假設。

papers.title: Bridging energy and proteome allocation models allows prediction of the resource cost of traits across environments
papers.abstract: Many traits divert resources from reproduction and are costly due to the physiological trade-offs organisms face. These traits might require the allocation of different resources, e.g., energy expenditure or production of macromolecules, and it is unclear how their costs can be compared given their different units. Moreover, the effect of environmental conditions and genetic background on the cost of traits is not well understood. Two different frameworks have been proposed to quantify the resource costs of traits, focusing on either energy allocation or proteome allocation. These frameworks implicitly assume energy provisioning or protein production limits growth, respectively, but the connection between the two limitations has been underexplored. To better connect these frameworks, we develop a framework that considers limitations in energy provisioning and macromolecule biosynthesis simultaneously to quantify and compare the cost of traits that require different resources. Using this model, we explore how environmental quality and genetic background affect the cost of traits. Notably, our model predicts that increasing food quality increases the cost of traits that require the production of new structures, while decreasing the cost of traits requiring energy expenditure. Moreover, our model makes novel predictions about the effect of degradation, recycling, and energetic demands for maintenance on the relationship between the macromolecular composition of the cells and growth rate (also known as bacterial growth laws).
papers.titleZh: 整合能量與蛋白質體分配模型預測性狀資源成本
papers.summaryZh: 本研究提出一個同時考慮能量供應與大分子生物合成限制的框架，用以量化並比較需要不同資源的性狀成本。該框架整合了先前分別聚焦能量分配與蛋白質體分配的兩種量化方法。模型探討環境品質與遺傳背景如何影響性狀成本。模型預測，食物品質提升會提高需要產生新結構的性狀成本，同時降低需要能量消耗的性狀成本。此外，模型對降解、回收以及維持所需能量對細胞大分子組成與生長速率關係的影響提出新預測。

papers.title: PrimeStack editors enable efficient and site-specific integration of large multigene cargos in plants
papers.abstract: Precise, site-specific integration of large DNA sequences into plant genomes is a long-standing goal of crop biotechnology and synthetic biology, yet remains constrained by random insertion, inefficient homologous recombination, and gene targeting. Here, we present PrimeStack, a DSB-independent platform that integrates PE with the unidirectional large serine integrase Bxb1, leveraging evolved variants for enhanced activity, to achieve the programmable insertion of multigene, multikilobase cargos at predefined genomic safe harbors (GSH) in rice ( Oryza sativa ). Optimized prime editors first install attP landing sites with high fidelity and heritability followed by Bxb1-mediated recombination that generates irreversible integration of genetic information. PrimeStack enabled targeted large-cargo integration in regenerated rice plants with efficiencies of up to 45%, as determined by junction-specific PCR analyses. No obvious morphological differences from WT plants were observed at 5 weeks after transfer to soil under the evaluated conditions. We validate its utility by achieving targeted insertion of a carotenoid cassette at an experimentally confirmed genomic safe harbor. PrimeStack delivers a modular, site-specific gene stacking platform that enables predictable, multigene trait pyramiding and pathway construction at GSH, thereby accelerating the development of improved and resilient crop varieties, as well as scalable plant-based biomanufacturing and a powerful chassis for synthetic biology.
papers.titleZh: PrimeStack 編輯器實現水稻基因組安全港的大型多基因載荷定點整合
papers.summaryZh: 研究團隊提出 PrimeStack，一個不依賴雙股斷裂的平台，將 Prime Editing 與單向大型絲胺酸整合酶 Bxb1 結合，並使用演化後的高活性變異體，以在水稻 Oryza sativa 的預定義基因組安全港進行多基因、多千鹼基載荷的可程式化插入。優化後的 prime editor 先以高保真且可遺傳的方式安裝 attP 降落位點，接著由 Bxb1 介導的重組產生不可逆的整合。PrimeStack 在再生水稻植株中實現定點大型載荷整合，效率最高達 45%，以接合點特異性 PCR 分析判定。在評估條件下，轉移至土壤後 5 週未觀察到與野生型植株明顯的形態差異。研究以在實驗確認的基因組安全港定點插入類胡蘿蔔素 cassette 驗證其用途。

papers.title: An inositol receptor Itr4 coordinates carbon catabolite regulation and virulence in Cryptococcus neoformans
papers.abstract: Nutrient sensing and utilization are critical for microbes to adapt to their environment and evade predators. The encapsuled yeast Cryptococcus neoformans has a unique ability to sense and utilize the sugar inositol as both a signaling molecule and as a carbon source. This trait is advantageous not only in the natural environment but also to promote its pathogenesis, including invasion of the central nervous system. In this study, we have identified a novel inositol transporter-like receptor (transceptor) Itr4 that coordinates inositol and glucose metabolism by regulating inositol transporters ( ITR s) and glucose sensor Hxs1. Itr4 binds inositol and regulates the function of other ITR s and its loss leads to a significant decrease in inositol uptake activity, resulting in a lack of mating, reduced capsule size, reduced blood–brain barrier (BBB) penetration, and virulence attenuation. Mutagenesis analysis of Itr4 protein identified an essential N-terminal tail and two amino acids, Q388 and Q389, as sites of functional importance. The ITR4 Q388A, Q389A allele showed a dominant phenotype with increased inositol uptake, enlarged capsule and significantly attenuated virulence. In summary, we identify a new C. neoformans inositol transceptor, Itr4, the first such example in eukaryotes, with novel regulatory roles in both inositol and glucose metabolism and fungal virulence.
papers.titleZh: 肌醇受體 Itr4 調控碳源利用與致病性
papers.summaryZh: 本研究在包囊酵母 Cryptococcus neoformans 中鑑定出新型肌醇轉運體樣受體 Itr4，據稱是真核生物中首例此類肌醇轉受體。Itr4 能結合肌醇，並透過調控肌醇轉運蛋白 ITRs 與葡萄糖感應器 Hxs1 來協調肌醇與葡萄糖代謝。失去 Itr4 會顯著降低肌醇攝取活性，導致交配缺失、包囊大小減少、血腦屏障穿透力下降以及毒力減弱。突變分析指出 Itr4 的 N 端尾部為必需，且胺基酸 Q388 與 Q389 在功能上重要。Itr4 Q388A、Q389A 等位基因呈現顯性表型，肌醇攝取增加、包囊增大且毒力顯著減弱。

papers.title: Escape from replicative crisis and immortalization precedes complex genome evolution
papers.abstract: Shortening of telomeres restricts the proliferative capacity of human somatic cells by inducing replicative senescence and crisis. During cancerous transformation, premalignant cells must overcome these barriers and acquire replicative immortality. Single-cell DNA strand-specific genome sequencing of crisis cells revealed extreme genome instability characterized by complex chromosomal abnormalities. Unexpectedly, spontaneously emerging postcrisis clones showed relatively few and simple structural variants. However, with accumulating divisions following crisis escape, the genomes of immortal postcrisis clones evolve and amass genomic alterations, including tetraploidization events with subsequent losses and gains of individual chromosomes. Our data point towards a new model of tumorigenesis in which crisis acts as a strong selective barrier against cells with aberrant karyotypes, and in which high karyotypic complexity is acquired after immortalization and crisis escape.
papers.titleZh: 逃脫複製危機與不朽化先於複雜基因組演化

papers.title: Rethinking Syndecan-1 as a Marker of Trauma-Induced Endothelial Injury
papers.abstract: Syndecan-1 (SDC1), a transmembrane proteoglycan and component of the glycocalyx, is widely considered the key circulating biomarker of endothelial dysfunction in trauma and critical illness. However, the tissue distribution of SDC1 and the cellular origin of plasma SDC1 in health and disease are incompletely understood. This series of experiments integrates immunostaining, spatial transcriptomics (GeoMx Digital Spatial Profiler (DSP) and Xenium), and single-cell atlases to map SDC1, as well as the other three members of the syndecan family, syndecan-2 (SDC2), syndecan-3 (SDC3), and syndecan-4 (SDC4), across mouse and human tissues, including the lung, gastrointestinal tract, and brain. Across modalities, SDC1 primarily localizes to epithelial compartments, as demonstrated by colocalization with epithelial markers and enrichment in epithelial cell types in the lung and gut. Spatial profiling further identifies SDC1 and SDC4 enrichment in airway epithelial niches, SDC3 in endothelial-rich regions, and SDC2 distributed more broadly across compartments. Mouse and human single-cell atlases confirm epithelial predominance of SDC1. These findings define the cellular and spatial landscape of syndecan expression in healthy tissues and support SDC1 as an epithelial-enriched proteoglycan. These results also challenge the specificity of circulating SDC1 as a biomarker of endotheliopathy and raise the possibility that epithelial injury contributes substantially to circulating SDC1 after trauma and critical illness.
papers.titleZh: 重新思考 Syndecan-1 作為創傷誘發內皮損傷的標記

papers.title: BioMod: Biological Module Tokenization for Single-Cell Foundation Modeling
papers.abstract: Single-cell foundation models typically represent cells as flat sequences of individual genes, requiring higher-order biological organization to be inferred implicitly from sparse expression profiles. Similar to the evolution from character-level to semantic tokenization in natural language processing,we hypothesize that cellular states can be more efficiently represented using biologically meaningful intermediate units. Here we present BioMod, a 50-million-parameter single-cell foundation model that introduces biological modules as representation units between genes and cells. BioMod constructs an overlapping vocabulary of 660 biological modules derived from curated pathways and data-driven gene programs, replacing thousands of gene-level inputs with compact module representations. Pretrained on approximately 73 million human cells using high-ratio module masking with an asymmetric decoder, BioMod achieves state-of-the-art performance across cell-type annotation, zero-shot batch integration, perturbation-response prediction and drug-response forecasting while maintaining a compact architecture that enables efficient inference on a single GPU. Module-level analyses further demonstrate that BioMod captures biologically meaningful cellular programs and preserves pathway-level organization.
papers.titleZh: 以生物模組為語彙單位的單細胞基礎模型
papers.summaryZh: 本文提出 BioMod，一個約 5 千萬參數的單細胞基礎模型，將細胞狀態的表徵從基因層級提升至生物模組層級。模型建構出 660 個重疊的生物模組語彙，來源為 curated pathways 與資料驅動的基因程式，並以此取代數千個基因輸入。BioMod 在約 7,300 萬個人類細胞上以高比例模組遮罩與非對稱解碼器進行預訓練。作者報告模型在細胞型別註解、零樣本批次整合、擾動反應預測與藥物反應預測等任務上達到 state-of-the-art 表現，且可在單張 GPU 上進行高效推論。模組層級分析顯示 BioMod 能捕捉具生物意義的細胞程式並保留路徑層級組織。

papers.title: A multimodal foundation model to integrate histology with spatial molecular programs
papers.abstract: Histology and spatial transcriptomics provide complementary views of cancer morphology and molecular organization, yet their spatial correspondence has not been learned at scale. We developed SQUALL, a multimodal foundation model pretrained on histMol, comprising 1.93 billion spatially aligned histology-transcriptomics spots/bins from 3,446 sections across 33 tissues and 12 platforms. By learning spatial morphology-molecular correspondences, SQUALL enables virtual spatial transcriptomics, tumor microenvironment characterization, and molecularly informed histology representations for clinical prediction. SQUALL generalized virtual spatial gene expression profiling across cohorts, cancers, and platforms. Its representations resolve tumor microenvironments including progression-associated tumor trajectories in breast cancer and recurrence-associated immune-excluded regions in ovarian tumor, together with underlying transcriptional programs. Applied to whole-slide histology, SQUALL enabled outcome and treatment-response prediction while revealing interpretable features associated with risk. Together, these results establish large-scale spatially aligned histology-transcriptomics pretraining as a general framework for connecting tissue morphology, molecular programs, microenvironmental organization, and clinical phenotypes.
papers.titleZh: 整合組織學與空間分子程序的多模態基礎模型
papers.summaryZh: 研究指出組織學與空間轉錄體學提供癌症形態與分子組織的互補觀點，但其空間對應關係尚未在大規模上被學習。作者開發了 SQUALL，一個多模態基礎模型，於 histMol 上預訓練，包含來自 33 種組織、12 個平台的 3,446 個切片中 19.3 億個空間對齊的組織學-轉錄體學 spots/bins。透過學習空間形態-分子對應，SQUALL 可實現虛擬空間轉錄體學、腫瘤微環境特徵描述，以及用於臨床預測的分子資訊型組織學表徵。SQUALL 在不同隊列、癌症與平台間泛化虛擬空間基因表現分析，其表徵可解析腫瘤微環境，包括乳癌中與進展相關的腫瘤軌跡，以及卵巢腫瘤中與復發相關的免疫排除區域，並伴隨底層轉錄程序。在全切片組織學上的應用顯示 SQUALL 可進行預後與治療反應預測，並揭示與風險相關的可解釋特徵。

papers.title: A split-control criterion for few-shot adaptation in single-cell perturbation prediction
papers.abstract: Few-shot adaptation can help or harm single-cell perturbation prediction, but conventional evaluation shares a control estimate between calibration responses and held-out targets. We show how methods carry control error into their predictions and derive its contribution to score inflation. Nested control-depth experiments support inverse-depth scaling of inner-product inflation; correlation inflation also depends on the control noise-to-signal ratio. Independent-control scoring changed the rank of 40 of 52 configuration-dataset entries. We introduce SafeDelta, a split-control criterion that uses calibration data to decide whether to adapt. Across six datasets, mean gated gain was non-negative under the original two-control evaluation. On a deep plate, fixed predictions and decisions retained positive mean gains under three additional independent control references. The same reproducibility principle identified a fibrosis programme that localises to scar in human liver. These results inform adaptation decisions and control-depth planning.
papers.titleZh: 單細胞擾動預測中少樣本適應的分離對照準則
papers.summaryZh: 本預印本探討少樣本適應對單細胞擾動預測可能產生幫助或傷害，並指出傳統評估共用對照估計於校準回應與保留目標的問題。作者說明方法如何將對照誤差帶入預測並推導其對分數膨脹的貢獻，並以巢狀對照深度實驗支持內積膨脹隨深度反向縮放，以及相關膨脹依賴對照雜訊與訊號比。採用獨立對照評分後，52個組態資料集項目中有40個的排名改變。作者提出 SafeDelta，一個使用校準資料決定是否適應的分離對照準則。在六個資料集上，原本的雙對照評估下平均閘控增益為非負。在深度盤上，固定預測與決策在三個額外的獨立對照參考下仍保持正平均增益。同一可重現性原則亦辨識出一個纖維化程式，其在人類肝臟中定位於疤痕。

papers.title: ALBIS: simulation of multi-resolution and multi-dimensional spatial transcriptomics data
papers.abstract: The rapid adoption of spatial transcriptomics (ST) technologies has been accompanied by substantial growth in computational methods, creating an increasing need for systematic and reliable benchmarking, particularly as analyses increasingly extend from individual tissue sections to three-dimensional (3D) tissue reconstruction. Existing benchmarks often rely on a small and similar set of experimentally-derived datasets because they offer a reliable ground truth label, which is hard to find in practice. Simulated or synthetic data provide an alternative, yet most existing simulators either adapt single-cell RNA-sequencing models to spatial coordinates or generate individual sections in a two-dimensional (2D) space at predefined resolutions. More recent approaches can simulate 2D and 3D tissues, but generally do not derive multiple spatial resolutions from the same molecular realization. Here, we introduce ALBIS (A muLti-resolution Biological In-silico Simulator for spatial transcriptomics), a statistically grounded and highly customizable framework that generates synthetic ST data from an in silico 3D tissue. ALBIS defines spatially structured cell populations with corresponding markers for gene expression, then initializes individual mRNA molecules in 3D space to create cell-level information with a ground truth 3D coordinate for each molecule and cell. From this common realization, ALBIS cuts the 3D tissue into multiple 2D tissue sections with cell-, bin-, and spot-level measurements, enabling direct comparison across spatial resolutions. Properties of the simulated data, including spatial domains, cell type composition, gene-expression effects, batch effects, measurement resolution, and tissue scale, can be systematically varied, enabling rigorous stress-testing of computational methods under known and increasingly challenging conditions.
papers.titleZh: 多解析度多維度空間轉錄組模擬器 ALBIS
papers.summaryZh: 研究團隊提出 ALBIS，一個統計基礎且高度可客製化的框架，用於從體內模擬 3D 組織生成合成空間轉錄組學資料。ALBIS 先定義具有基因表現標記的空間結構化細胞族群，並在 3D 空間中初始化個別 mRNA 分子，為每個分子與細胞建立真實的 3D 座標。從同一組模擬結果，ALBIS 可將 3D 組織切成多個 2D 組織切片，並產生細胞、bin 與 spot 等不同解析度的測量。模擬資料的空間域、細胞類型組成、基因表現效應、批次效應、測量解析度與組織尺度等特性皆可系統性調整。該方法旨在提供已知條件下對計算方法進行嚴格壓力測試的基準，特別針對從單一組織切片到三維重建的分析需求。

papers.title: Spatially resolved tumor-microenvironment architecture defines therapeutic response in unresectable hepatoblastoma
papers.abstract: Background: Hepatoblastoma exhibits variable therapeutic response that is not fully explained by current risk stratification. While prior studies have characterized tumor composition, the role of spatial organization in determining outcome, particularly in unresectable disease requiring transplantation under immunosuppression, remains unclear. Methods: We integrated spatial transcriptomics using the 10x Genomics Visium platform (n = 11 tumors) with single-cell spatial molecular imaging using NanoString CosMx (n = 3 tumors) on post-chemotherapy explant specimens across clinically defined groups (relapse-prone unresectable, non-relapse unresectable, and resectable hepatoblastoma). Spatial deconvolution, module scoring, spatial co-localization, and cell-cell interaction analyses were used to define region-level transcriptional programs and their underlying cellular organization. Results: We identified three spatial architectures associated with clinical outcome. Relapse-prone tumors exhibited a centralized, TME-dominated organization enriched for progenitor-like, cycling, and stress-responsive tumor cell states co-localized with SPP1+ TAMs and CAFs, with enrichment of hypoxia response, extracellular matrix remodeling, and Midkine (MDK-LRP1) signaling. Non-relapse tumors displayed a distributed architecture with compartmentalized tumor-immune interactions, increased immune engagement, and preserved epithelial differentiation, including inflammatory hepatocyte-like states. Resection samples showed reduced tumor cell state heterogeneity and more uniform TME-immune organization. Conclusions: Integration of regional and single-cell spatial transcriptomics across two platforms reveals that the chemo-remodeled tumor architecture of hepatoblastoma encodes spatially organized tumor cell-TME interactions as central determinants of therapeutic response.

papers.title: Spatial context of cellular heterogeneity in triple-negative breast cancer reveals actionable subtypes
papers.abstract: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) is an aggressive, heterogeneous disease with limited targeted treatment options. Leveraging bulk and spatial transcriptomics and cellular mapping of breast tissue from a large patient cohort, we identified three reproducible TNBC ecosystem subtypes that encode distinct spatial tumor-microenvironment architectures and clinically relevant treatment-response phenotype. Our analyses define: (1) an immune-exhausted subtype associated with immune checkpoint therapy (ICT); (2) a highly fibrotic/hypoxic subtype; and (3) a metabolically reprogrammed subtype characterized by nuclear-receptor and fatty-acid signaling. Spatial profiling further revealed subtype-specific organization of epithelial, immune, and stromal programs across tumor centers and invasive edges. Multiplexed imaging independently supported the contrasting immune-infiltrated and stromal-excluded architectures of the immune-engaged and fibrotic subtypes. The unique markers associated with the subtypes also provide the basis for subtyping and candidate therapeutic vulnerabilities. Our study provides a robust framework for personalized medicine, highlighting that targeting specific spatio-cellular architectures is critical to improving clinical outcomes.

papers.title: Spatial transcriptomics reveals interferon pathway enrichment in early relapsing serous carcinoma
papers.abstract: High-grade serous carcinoma (HGSC) is characterized by extensive inter and intra-patient heterogeneity, complicating the identification of reliable prognostic biomarkers and the prediction of treatment response. In clinical practice, the origin of diagnostic biopsies varies, from tubo-ovarian (adnexal) tissue to omental or peritoneal metastatic foci. Whether the different sites provide similar information for molecular characterization or treatment decisions remains unclear. Studies comparing site-specific molecular details and the spatial relationship of HGSC tissue from patients with different treatment outcomes could provide answers to the open questions. Here, we used spatial transcriptomics to profile matched treatment-naive adnexal and omental tumor samples from nine HGSC patients stratified by platinum-free interval (PFI). Pathway enrichment analysis revealed several differences between short and medium- and long PFI tumors, however most of these differences were site-agnostic. Most strikingly, tumor epithelium from short PFI patients showed an inflammatory phenotype driven by increased interferon response signaling, carried by effector interferon-stimulated gene expression at both tumor sites. Further, medium- and long PFI tumors were enriched for proliferative and cell cycle regulatory programs. Differential gene expression and copy-number analyses identified three genes, complement gene C3, and interferon-related genes IFI27 and BST2, consistently associated with short PFI across adnexal and omental sites. These were validated at the tissue level using RNA in-situ hybridization. A case study of copy-number-defined subclones further suggested that this phenotype can arise as a distinct subclonal population within a single tumor. Outcome analysis, using two publicly available ovarian cancer cohorts, showed that high C3 expression was significantly associated with shorter platinum-free survival. Together, these findings implicate complement and interferon signaling as concurrent features of treatment-naive HGSC tumors with early relapse in both adnexal and omental tissue, and nominate C3 as a candidate prognostic biomarker and potential therapeutic target.

papers.title: Single-Cell Multimodal Profiling Reveals Maternal Diabetes-Nkx2-5 Interaction in Congenital Heart Disease in a Genetic Model Recapitulating Human Embryopathies
papers.abstract: The etiological complexity of congenital heart disease (CHD) arises from the interaction between genetic and environmental factors. We hypothesized that environmental exposure could potentiate a genetic susceptibility, leading to an increased incidence of specific cardiac defects. To test this hypothesis, we used betaV59M+ female mice exhibiting severe hyperglycemia (>28 mmol/L) without dyslipidemia, a model we characterized that faithfully recapitulates human diabetic embryopathy. These females were crossed with males haploinsufficient for Nkx2-5, a transcription factor essential for cardiac development and implicated in human CHD. Our results show that the combination of genetic susceptibility and a hyperglycemic maternal environment (GxE) leads to a higher frequency and severity of cardiac malformations, including ventricular septal defects specifically involving the muscular septum, univentricular morphologies, and dilation with thinning of the myocardium. These structural abnormalities were associated with transcriptional changes affecting the contractile identity of the chamber myocardium. Single-nucleus multiomic profiling (snRNA-seq and snATAC-seq) of the E9.5 cardiac region revealed that the interaction between maternal diabetes and Nkx2-5 haploinsufficiency profoundly reshapes transcriptional and chromatin accessibility landscapes. These changes affect not only metabolic pathways, but also cell cycle progression in second heart field (SHF) progenitors, likely contributing to the observed structural cardiac defects. Multiomic integration further identifies a disrupted indirect Nkx2-5-Aldh1a2 regulatory axis in posterior SHF progenitors, while demonstrating that maternal diabetes selectively affects a restricted subset of Nkx2-5-dependent regulatory elements associated with cardiomyocyte maturation. Our findings establish a comprehensive single-cell multiomic resource that will facilitate the integration of human GWAS and other genomic datasets, enabling the identification and functional interpretation of disease-associated loci.
